name: desktop-project-work-local
goal: Expose the committed project Work snapshot to the local Electron renderer without widening remote access.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The Work backend exposes projectWork for a selected project, but Electron preload and the local wire method catalog omit it; a local renderer cannot request its committed feature snapshot.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing local socket bridge case covers other project operations but never requests projectWork; extend that same method case and verify local-only permission without changing established behavior.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: b2082a8dc9d05d70d727e14c663e675205dbe4036068e9b1e00c6911c934a1c7: local transport reports the projectWork operation does not exist at the committed test revision.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Added projectWork to local-only wire methods and exposed it from the Electron preload; local selection checks remain in the existing bridge.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: d10fb56f0fe2dcb1ebd9606121a4c41bcef26fad660369a93e4b4048a1953e56 passed the unchanged clean-snapshot socket case in the same environment as red 9f9bc1b2d4b13bf1752c629740bceb0968069d30e6ad96630197ae26b5e80ac5.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
